items.criterion: The download route refuses a share whose download is switched off.
items.judgment: Request the download route of the seeded open share and read the status.

items.criterion: Two claims on the last monthly variation unit admit exactly one.
items.judgment: Race two variation exports at nineteen of twenty and count the successes.

items.criterion: A repeated request key returns one export job and one reserved unit.
items.judgment: Send the same request key twice and count the stored jobs.

items.criterion: A ready export file sits in the bucket at its export key.
items.judgment: Upload a matching png and check the object key in the bucket.

items.criterion: A mismatched export file fails the job and releases its unit.
items.judgment: Upload a wrong-sized png and read the job state and the usage.

items.criterion: Two saves from one revision leave one stored timeline.
items.judgment: Race two saves from revision one and read the stored revision.

items.criterion: A mid-period Pro join writes a prorated seat charge.
items.judgment: Accept an invitation in the seeded Pro workspace and compare the charge with the formula.

items.criterion: Seeded comments follow their item into the newer version or read orphaned.
items.judgment: List the seeded version two comments and read their state and moment.

items.criterion: Reviewers are denied every workspace endpoint.
items.judgment: Call workspace endpoints with both reviewer sessions and read the statuses.

items.criterion: An approved project reads outdated after a later save.
items.judgment: Approve a version, save the timeline and read the project approval status.

items.criterion: Uploaded bytes sit in the bucket at their digest key once.
items.judgment: Upload the same bytes twice and list the workspace prefix.

items.criterion: Each paid plan reports its computed annual saving.
items.judgment: Read the plans list and compare each saving with its prices.
